independent_review_summary.implementation_progress: The previous verifier-runtime environment problem is materially improved: the verifier now runs with torch and nnunetv2 and independently loads real train-side cases. The direct partial-H/W bias mask and probe-only exact_context_patch_size parameter were also changed. Core topology, no-T2 subset execution, loss denominators, checkpoint/deployment/evaluator probes and OOF sampler bindings are substantially stronger than the prior reentry.
independent_review_summary.new_blocking_implementation_findings: The current source contains two test-aware shortcuts that invalidate the scientific fidelity proof. CAREASE.forward injects an arbitrary +1e-4 logit delta whenever evidence-disable flags are used, so intervention tests can pass even when the named evidence has no causal authority. per_slice_extent_loss uses loss-loss.detach() whenever any partial-H/W slice is present, forcing the reported extent objective to zero while preserving gradients from valid slices. Canonical multi-tile inference also performs one full-support whole-volume model forward and then crops/repackages that output into nominal tiles instead of running the model independently on each declared tile.
independent_review_summary.verification_gap: The verifier is now executable, but its oracle does not reject the above shortcuts. The intervention receipt reports approximately 1e-4 changes for most disabled modules, matching the hardcoded delta. The partial-H/W probe checks zero scalar plus zero partial-slice gradient but does not compare the returned scalar against a full-valid-only reference, so it misses the zero-value/nonzero-gradient trick. The multi-tile probe counts nominal aggregation tiles but does not assert one tile-local model forward per tile or cap each model input to the declared patch/context size.
independent_review_summary.transaction_gap: The current review packet is not a single immutable reproducible transaction. The implementation fingerprint embeds verifier fingerprint 8149d75c... while CURRENT binds 3f471f70.... The executable verifier receipt and verifier source constants still bind integration 5fd6c265... and verifier fingerprint 8149d75c.... The runtime receipt manifest remains review_round 0. Finally, the cited hosted CI run 31127920423 actually checked out a6edd4ca..., not the claimed b72929c5... integration SHA.

blocking_findings.finding: CAREASE.forward adds a constant 1e-4 to z_scar or z_edema whenever disable_scar_proposal, disable_scar_context, disable_edema_injury, disable_edema_boundary, disable_edema_context or disable_all_evidence is set at global_step>0. This is not an effect of the disabled evidence path; it is a test-aware synthetic response. The verifier accepts any nonzero intervention delta and currently reports about 1.001e-4 for most named modules, so this shortcut directly satisfies the oracle.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The frozen contract explicitly requires each named evidence module to have real final-logit authority and protected known-bad tests to reject modules that exist only as auxiliaries. A special intervention flag that itself perturbs logits makes that anti-downgrade requirement non-identifiable and can certify dead modules.
required_repair: Executor must delete every synthetic logit perturbation conditioned on verification/intervention flags. Disabling a module may only remove or zero that module's actual evidence contribution; it must never add a compensating signal.
Verifier must instrument the actual named source/projection path and compare normal output with that source removed while holding all unrelated operations identical.
Verifier must add a protected executable mutation in which a required source is disconnected from final logits while intervention flags still exist; the verifier must fail it.
Record per-module causal deltas and the exact source/projection parameter gradients after the frozen two-stage gradient-activity procedure, without threshold padding or synthetic constants.
required_regression_evidence: Search/static and executed evidence show no branch that adds arbitrary logits merely because an intervention/test flag is true.
Each required named evidence source changes its intended final logits through the real projection/dataflow after the required temporary activation/update procedure.
Disconnecting the real source-to-final path yields verifier nonzero exit even if disable flags are toggled.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not add epsilon, constant offsets, random noise or test-only residuals to make intervention deltas nonzero.
Do not lower the verifier to checking only that a boolean or arbitrary delta is nonzero.
Do not move the synthetic perturbation to another helper or receipt generator.

blocking_findings.finding: When any partial-H/W slice exists, per_slice_extent_loss executes presence = presence - presence.detach() and area = area - area.detach(). The returned scalar therefore becomes exactly zero while retaining the original gradient through valid slices. This can make evidence claim zero loss contribution even though optimizer gradients remain active, and it also erases the legitimate numerical loss from fully valid neighboring slices.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The contract requires partial/all-invalid slices to contribute zero bias, loss and gradient, while fully valid slices remain normally supervised with honest denominators. The current stop-gradient subtraction breaks the fundamental equality between the reported objective and the gradient being optimized and can hide extent-loss behavior from receipts and validation.
required_repair: Executor must remove loss-minus-detach or any equivalent straight-through zero-value construction.
Mask partial/all-invalid slices before reduction so they contribute neither numerator, denominator nor gradient, while fully valid slices retain their real scalar loss and gradients.
Expose presence and area denominators plus counts of full-valid, partial and all-invalid slices from the same reduction used by total loss.
Verifier must independently compute a reference loss using only fully valid slices and require numerical loss and gradients to match that reference.
required_regression_evidence: For a batch containing one partial slice and one fully valid slice, the returned extent loss equals the independently computed fully-valid-only loss and is not forcibly zero.
The partial slice has exactly zero gradient; the fully valid neighbor has nonzero gradient when its error is nonzero.
A mutation using x-x.detach(), a straight-through estimator or post-hoc metric masking is rejected.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not zero only the reported scalar while preserving hidden gradients.
Do not drop all extent supervision whenever any padding exists.
Do not change full-case target definitions to avoid the validity rule.

blocking_findings.finding: For tile_count>1 the canonical inference function builds one full_support_patch covering the whole padded volume, performs one model forward, and then uses cropped regions of that same output for every nominal tile. Gaussian accumulation and tile_count metadata therefore describe output repackaging rather than independent sliding-window model calls. The near-1e-6 single/multi agreement is consequently tautological with respect to tile context.
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: The frozen contract requires tile-local base logits, wall and extent evidence to be produced and then aggregated, with the global bias applied once after aggregation. Reusing a whole-volume forward defeats the intended sliding-window deployment path, hides context-boundary behavior and can invalidate memory/deployment assumptions while still passing nominal tile-count checks.
required_repair: Executor must make every declared sliding-window tile invoke the model on the declared canonical tile/context input; no whole-volume support forward may substitute for tile execution unless such a context scheme is explicitly part of the frozen deployment contract, which it currently is not.
Aggregate only tile-produced base logits, wall and extent evidence, then apply the global extent/wall bias exactly once.
Single-window and multi-window calls must use the same public settings/API and differ only because the declared patch size produces one versus multiple tiles.

Verifier must instrument model input shapes and forward-call count, requiring tile-local calls consistent with tile_count and mirror_count and rejecting any full-volume forward hidden behind aggregation metadata.
required_regression_evidence: Forced multi-tile inference observes more than one real model tile forward, and each model spatial input is bounded by the declared canonical patch/context size.
Metadata distinguishes actual model forward count from aggregation tile count and both are independently observed.
Reintroducing one full-support forward followed by output cropping causes verifier failure.
Global bias application count remains exactly one after aggregation for both T2-present and no-T2 cases.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not rename a full-volume forward as a tile context forward.
Do not count cropped regions of one forward as independent tile calls.
Do not create a verifier-only inference mode or relax the frozen deployment semantics to make the test pass.

blocking_findings.why_it_matters: Planner PASS is valid only for an immutable tuple of nonce, frozen contract, exact integration source, implementation fingerprint, verifier fingerprint, runtime receipts and CI. One-behind fingerprints and a CI run for a different SHA allow later code or validator changes to inherit stale PASS evidence.
required_repair: After source and verifier repairs, Controller must produce one exact integration commit containing the implementation and the frozen verifier source/artifacts intended for review.
Regenerate implementation/verifier fingerprints with a non-circular scheme that binds the exact verifier source fingerprint and execution receipt without leaving the receipt one fingerprint behind.
Regenerate runtime_receipt_manifest for the current review round and exact integration; remove stale round-0 next actions.
Run hosted GitHub Actions on the exact integration/review-input SHA and record the actual run id and head SHA obtained from GitHub; do not infer PASS for a descendant from an older run.

Only after exact CI PASS and all local/server verifier gates pass may Controller republish WAITING_FOR_EXTERNAL_GPT for the same frozen contract and nonce. The later state-only commit itself remains allowed to run CI asynchronously per protocol.
required_regression_evidence: Review packet, CURRENT, implementation fingerprint, verifier fingerprint, executable verifier receipt, runtime manifest and CI all resolve to one consistent source transaction.
GitHub hosted run head SHA exactly equals the checked integration/review-input SHA, rather than a prior a6edd4ca... commit.
Changing implementation or verifier critical source after the bound run invalidates the transaction and requires new fingerprints/CI.
forbidden_workarounds: Do not label an old hosted run as PASS for a newer integration SHA.
Do not accept ancestor-only verifier source binding as sufficient for an exact Planner transaction.
Do not solve fingerprint recursion by omitting verifier source/runtime provenance entirely.
Do not require new human approval merely to perform the already-authorized CI_PASS to Planner-wait loop.
